title: groupcounts
summary: Count the number of elements in each group.

gpu_support.notes: Grouping runs on the host. Automatic internal residency gathers transparently; explicit interactive gpuArray input is a declared RunMat-only extension.

description: `B = groupcounts(A)` returns counts for each sorted group in array data, including the missing group by default. For table input, `groupcounts(T,vars)` returns a table with grouping variables, `GroupCount`, and `Percent`.
behaviors: Supports array, cell-array-of-grouping-vectors, and table grouping inputs.
All eight integer classes are documented grouping data and are compared from authoritative storage, including distinct uint64 values above flintmax.

The one-group form supports numeric edges and positive bin counts together with IncludedEdge, IncludeEmptyGroups, and IncludeMissingGroups. Exact integer edges never cross a floating comparison boundary. Multi-group bin specifications and time bins are not currently supported.
Native typed-integer bin counts and boolean controls are independently gated RunMat extensions; equivalent double and logical controls remain available in MATLAB-compatible mode.
Missing groups are included by default. Count and percentage outputs are double, while unbinned grouping outputs preserve their integer class.
